hook.convey: one whole (a roti, a drawn circle) cut and shared → fair only if the pieces are the same size; equal pieces of one whole get the names half, third, quarter; the number of pieces alone does not decide the name

use.hi: Maa ne kitchen mein ek garam roti banayi, aur tum do bhai-behen ho. Roti ke 2 tukde honge. Aaj dekhenge ki dono ka hissa kab sach mein barabar hota hai.
use.en: Mum made a hot roti in the kitchen, and you are two siblings. The roti will become 2 pieces. Today we see when both shares are really equal.

use.hi: Apni drawing book mein ek gol circle draw karo. Hum usko barabar hisson mein baantenge aur ek hissa colour karenge. Phir us rangin hisse ka naam dhoondhenge.
use.en: Draw a round circle in your drawing book. We will split it into equal parts and colour one part. Then we will find the name of that coloured part.

explain.convey: roti cut into 2 same-size pieces → each piece = half = 1/2; bottom 2 = equal pieces in the whole, top 1 = pieces taken

point.hi: Dekho, roti ke 2 barabar tukde hain, aur 1 tukda rangin hai. Yeh tukda roti ka aadha hai, yaani 1/2. Neeche wala 2 batata hai ki poori roti ke kitne barabar tukde bane. Upar wala 1 batata hai ki humne kitne tukde liye.
point.en: Look, the roti is in 2 equal pieces, and 1 piece is shaded. This piece is half the roti, that is 1/2. The bottom 2 tells how many equal pieces the whole roti made. The top 1 tells how many pieces we took.

prompt.hi: Is roti mein 1 tukda rangin hai aur 1 bina rang ka. Kya isliye rangin hissa 1/1 hai, haan ya nahi?
prompt.en: This roti has 1 shaded piece and 1 unshaded piece. So is the shaded part 1/1, yes or no?

why.hi: roti ke 2 barabar tukde hain, toh rangin 1 tukda 1/2 hai, 1/1 nahi
why.en: the roti has 2 equal pieces, so the 1 shaded piece is 1/2, not 1/1

simpler.hi: Neeche wala number poori roti ke saare barabar tukde ginta hai, rangin aur bina rang wale dono. Upar wala sirf rangin tukde ginta hai.
simpler.en: The bottom number counts all the equal pieces of the whole roti, shaded and unshaded. The top number counts only the shaded pieces.

explain.convey: both cakes have 3 pieces, but only same-size pieces get the name third; Cake A uneven → no thirds; Cake B equal → each piece 1/3

point.hi: Cake A ke bhi 3 tukde hain, Cake B ke bhi 3 tukde. Par Cake A mein 1 bada, 2 chhote hain, toh uska tukda 1/3 nahi hai. Cake B mein sab barabar hain, isliye wahan har tukda 1/3 hai, yaani ek-tihaai.
point.en: Cake A has 3 pieces, and Cake B has 3 pieces too. But Cake A has 1 big and 2 small, so its piece is not 1/3. In Cake B all are equal, so there each piece is 1/3, that is one-third.

prompt.hi: Ek pizza ke 3 tukde kiye: ek bada aur do chhote. Kya chhota tukda pizza ka ek-tihaai hai, haan ya nahi?
prompt.en: A pizza is cut into 3 pieces: one big and two small. Is a small piece one-third of the pizza, yes or no?

accept: no, the pieces are not equal

why.hi: pizza ke teeno tukde barabar nahi hain, aur ek-tihaai 3 barabar tukdon mein se ek hota hai
why.en: the pizza's three pieces are not equal, and one-third is one of 3 equal pieces

simpler.hi: Ek-tihaai tabhi hota hai jab 3 tukde bilkul barabar hon. Cake A ke tukde chhote-bade hain, Cake B ke sab barabar hain.
simpler.en: It is one-third only when the 3 pieces are exactly equal. Cake A's pieces are big and small; Cake B's are all equal.

explain.convey: drawn circle in 3 equal parts → one part = one-third = 1/3; bottom 3 = all the equal parts of the whole

point.hi: Is circle ke 3 barabar hisse hain, aur 1 hissa rangin hai. Yeh rangin hissa ek-tihaai hai, yaani 1/3. Neeche ka 3 poore circle ke saare barabar hisse batata hai.
point.en: This circle has 3 equal parts, and 1 part is shaded. This shaded part is one-third, that is 1/3. The bottom 3 tells all the equal parts of the whole circle.

prompt.hi: Agar is circle ka ek aur hissa bhi rang dein, toh circle ka kitna hissa rangin hoga, fraction mein?
prompt.en: If we shade one more part of this circle too, what fraction of the circle will be shaded?

why.hi: circle ke 3 barabar hisse hain aur ab unme se 2 rangin hain, yaani 2/3
why.en: the circle has 3 equal parts and now 2 of them are shaded, that is 2/3

simpler.hi: Circle ke 3 barabar hisse hain, toh neeche 3 aata hai. Upar utne hisse aate hain jitne rangin hon, abhi sirf 1.
simpler.en: The circle has 3 equal parts, so 3 goes at the bottom. At the top go as many parts as are shaded, right now just 1.

explain.convey: circle in 4 equal parts, 1 shaded → one quarter = 1/4; bottom = all 4 parts of the whole, never the 3 unshaded parts left → not 1/3

point.hi: Ab circle ke 4 barabar hisse hain. 1 hissa rangin hai, 3 bina rang ke. Rangin hissa ek-chauthaai hai, yaani 1/4. Neeche poore circle ke 4 hisse aate hain, bache hue 3 nahi.
point.en: Now the circle has 4 equal parts. 1 part is shaded, 3 are not. The shaded part is one-quarter, that is 1/4. At the bottom go all 4 parts of the whole circle, not the 3 left over.

prompt.hi: Ek pizza ke 4 barabar slice the. 1 slice kha liya gaya, aur 3 slice bache. {friend} ka kehna hai ki pizza ka 1/3 khaya gaya, kyunki 3 slice bache. Kya yeh sahi hai?
prompt.en: A pizza had 4 equal slices. 1 slice was eaten, and 3 slices were left. {friend} says 1/3 of the pizza was eaten, because 3 slices were left. Is that right?

why.hi: pizza ke 4 barabar slice the aur 1 khaya gaya, toh 1/4 khaya; bache hue 3 neeche nahi aate
why.en: the pizza had 4 equal slices and 1 was eaten, so 1/4 was eaten; the 3 left never go at the bottom

simpler.hi: Neeche hamesha poore ke saare hisse aate hain, yahan 4. Bache hue 3 hisse neeche nahi aate.
simpler.en: The bottom always has all the parts of the whole, here 4. The 3 parts left over do not go at the bottom.

problem.hi: Ek lambi barfi ke 3 barabar tukde kiye. Usme se 2 tukde kha liye. Barfi ka kitna hissa khaya gaya?
problem.en: A long barfi is cut into 3 equal pieces. 2 of the pieces are eaten. What fraction of the barfi is eaten?

find.hi: barfi ka kitna hissa khaya, fraction mein
find.en: the fraction of the barfi that is eaten

why.hi: neeche poori barfi ke saare barabar tukde aate hain
why.en: the bottom shows all the equal pieces of the whole barfi

simpler.hi: Poori barfi ke kitne barabar tukde bane, woh gino. Wahi number neeche likhte hain, yahan 3.
simpler.en: Count how many equal pieces the whole barfi made. That number goes at the bottom, here 3.

why.hi: upar woh tukde aate hain jo khaye gaye
why.en: the top shows the pieces that were eaten

simpler.hi: Ab sirf khaye hue tukde gino. Woh 2 hain, toh upar 2 aata hai.
simpler.en: Now count only the pieces that were eaten. There are 2, so 2 goes on top.

prompt.hi: Ab in dono numbers se fraction likho. Barfi ka kitna hissa khaya gaya?
prompt.en: Now write the fraction with these two numbers. What fraction of the barfi was eaten?

simpler.hi: Upar khaye hue tukde aate hain aur neeche saare tukde. Dono numbers ke beech ek line kheencho.
simpler.en: The eaten pieces go on top and all the pieces go at the bottom. Draw a line between the two numbers.

why.hi: barfi ke 3 barabar tukde the aur 2 khaye gaye, bacha hua 1 tukda neeche nahi aata
why.en: the barfi had 3 equal pieces and 2 were eaten; the 1 piece left over does not go at the bottom

prompt.hi: Ek laddoo ke 3 tukde hue: ek bada aur do chhote. Kya har tukda laddoo ka ek-tihaai hai?
prompt.en: A laddoo breaks into 3 pieces: one big and two small. Is each piece one-third of the laddoo?

accept: no, the pieces are not equal

why.hi: laddoo ke 3 tukde barabar nahi hain, ek bada aur do chhote
why.en: the laddoo's 3 pieces are not equal: one big and two small

simpler.hi: Ek-tihaai ke liye 3 tukde bilkul barabar hone chahiye. Dekho ki yahan ke tukde barabar hain ya chhote-bade.
simpler.en: For one-third, the 3 pieces must be exactly equal. Check whether these pieces are equal or big and small.

prompt.hi: Ek chocolate ke 3 barabar tukde kiye, aur 1 tukda kha liya. Chocolate ka kitna hissa khaya, fraction mein batao.
prompt.en: A chocolate bar is cut into 3 equal pieces, and 1 piece is eaten. What fraction of the chocolate bar is eaten?

why.hi: chocolate ke 3 barabar tukde the aur unme se 1 khaya gaya, yaani 1/3
why.en: the chocolate had 3 equal pieces and 1 of them was eaten, that is 1/3

simpler.hi: Neeche poori chocolate ke saare barabar tukde likho. Upar sirf khaya hua tukda likho.
simpler.en: At the bottom write all the equal pieces of the whole chocolate bar. On top write only the piece that was eaten.

prompt.hi: Ek cake ke 4 tukde kiye: 1 bada aur 3 chhote. {friend} ne 1 chhota tukda liya. Kya yeh chhota tukda cake ka ek-chauthaai hai?
prompt.en: A cake is cut into 4 pieces: 1 big and 3 small. {friend} takes 1 small piece. Is that small piece one quarter of the cake?

accept: no, the pieces are not equal

why.hi: cake ke 4 tukde barabar nahi hain, aur ek-chauthaai 4 barabar tukdon mein se 1 hota hai
why.en: the cake's 4 pieces are not equal, and one quarter is 1 of 4 equal pieces

simpler.hi: Ek-chauthaai tab hota hai jab 4 tukde bilkul barabar hon. Yahan bade aur chhote dono tukde hain, yeh dhyaan do.
simpler.en: It is one quarter only when the 4 pieces are exactly equal. Notice that here there are big and small pieces.

ladder.why: name one of 4 equal pieces → quarter, 1/4; warm-up naming
more than one part taken → 3 of 4 equal parts = 3/4; top number beyond 1
same count of pieces, different sizes → only equal pieces are thirds
error spot: parts left used as bottom → bottom = whole's equal parts
harder contrast with quarters on flags → equality decides, count alone does not

remediation.move: fair-sharing story: 3 friends, one watermelon cut as 1 big slice + 2 small → fair? no; then paper strip folded into 3 same-size parts beside it → only same-size parts carry the name third

say.hi: Tarbooz ka 1 bada tukda aur 2 chhote tukde barabar nahi hain, toh koi tukda 1/3 nahi. Kaagaz ki patti ke 3 barabar hisse hain, toh har hissa 1/3 hai.
say.en: A watermelon in 1 big slice and 2 small slices is not equal, so no slice is 1/3. A paper strip has 3 equal parts, so each part is 1/3.

simpler.hi: Tukde barabar hon, tabhi 1/3 hota hai. Tarbooz ke tukde chhote-bade hain, patti ke 3 hisse barabar hain.
simpler.en: Only equal pieces make 1/3. The watermelon slices are big and small; the strip's 3 parts are equal.

prompt.hi: Ek roti ke 2 tukde hue, ek bada aur ek chhota. Kya chhota tukda roti ka aadha hai?
prompt.en: A roti tears into 2 pieces, one bigger and one smaller. Is the smaller piece half of the roti?

why.hi: roti ke dono tukde barabar nahi hain, aur aadha 2 barabar tukdon mein se ek hota hai
why.en: the roti's two pieces are not equal, and a half is one of 2 equal pieces

simpler.hi: Aadha tab hota hai jab roti ke 2 tukde bilkul barabar hon. Yahan ek tukda bada hai aur ek chhota.
simpler.en: It is half only when the roti's 2 pieces are exactly equal. Here one piece is bigger and one is smaller.

remediation.move: switch from chocolate bar to a round roti cut into 4 equal sectors: whole roti first → its equal pieces give the bottom number; eaten pieces give the top; pieces left are a different question, never the bottom

say.hi: Poori roti ke 4 barabar tukde neeche aate hain, aur khaya hua 1 rangin tukda upar. Bache hue tukde neeche kabhi nahi aate.
say.en: The 4 equal pieces of the whole roti go at the bottom, and the 1 shaded piece eaten goes on top. The pieces left over never go at the bottom.

simpler.hi: Neeche poori roti ke saare barabar tukde, upar sirf khaye hue tukde. Bache hue tukde neeche kabhi nahi aate.
simpler.en: Bottom: all the equal pieces of the whole roti. Top: only the pieces eaten. The pieces left over never go at the bottom.

prompt.hi: Ek chocolate bar ke 4 barabar tukde kiye, aur 3 tukde kha liye. Bar ka kitna hissa khaya, fraction mein batao.
prompt.en: A chocolate bar is cut into 4 equal pieces, and 3 pieces are eaten. What fraction of the bar is eaten?

why.hi: bar ke 4 barabar tukde the aur unme se 3 khaye gaye, yaani 3/4
why.en: the bar had 4 equal pieces and 3 of them were eaten, that is 3/4

simpler.hi: Neeche bar ke saare barabar tukde aate hain, yaani 4. Upar sirf khaye hue tukde gino.
simpler.en: At the bottom go all the equal pieces of the bar, that is 4. On top count only the pieces that were eaten.

bridgeToNext.hi: Ab tak humne ek roti ke barabar hisse kiye. Ab bahut saare laddoo ke barabar group banakar hissa nikalenge. Niyam wahi hai: barabar hisse.
bridgeToNext.en: So far we made equal parts of one roti. Now we will find a part of many laddoos by making equal groups. The rule is the same: equal parts.

hook.convey: 8 laddoos (or 8 biscuits), 2 sharers, fair share → each share = half of the set; a fraction can be of a whole set, the set being the one whole

use.hi: Kitchen ke dibbe mein 8 laddoo hain, aur tum do bachche ho. Dono ko barabar laddoo milne chahiye. Aaj dekhenge ki 8 laddoo ka aadha kaise nikalte hain.
use.en: There are 8 laddoos in the kitchen box, and you are two children. Both must get equal laddoos. Today we see how to find half of 8 laddoos.

use.hi: Tumhare paas 8 biscuit hain aur 2 puppy hain. Dono puppy ko barabar biscuit milne chahiye. Ek puppy ka hissa 8 biscuit ka aadha hoga.
use.en: You have 8 biscuits and 2 puppies. Both puppies must get equal biscuits. One puppy's share will be half of the 8 biscuits.

explain.convey: 8 laddoos → 2 equal groups → 1/2 of 8 = one group = 4; check: 2 groups of 4 = 8

point.hi: Dekho, 8 laddoo 2 barabar group mein hain, har group mein 4. Ek group 8 ka aadha hai. Toh 8 ka 1/2 = 4. Check karo: 2 × 4 = 8.
point.en: Look, 8 laddoos are in 2 equal groups, 4 in each group. One group is half of 8. So 1/2 of 8 = 4. Check: 2 × 4 = 8.

prompt.hi: Ab dibbe mein 12 laddoo hain. 12 ka aadha kitna hai?
prompt.en: Now there are 12 laddoos in the box. What is half of 12?

why.hi: 12 laddoo ke 2 barabar group mein har group mein 6 aate hain, 2 × 6 = 12
why.en: 12 laddoos in 2 equal groups give 6 in each group, 2 × 6 = 12

simpler.hi: 8 laddoo ko 2 barabar group mein baanto, har group mein 4 aate hain. Ek group hi 8 ka aadha hai.
simpler.en: Share 8 laddoos into 2 equal groups, and each group gets 4. One group is half of 8.

explain.convey: 6 bananas → 3 equal groups → 1/3 of 6 = one group = 2; bottom 3 = number of equal groups, top 1 = groups taken

point.hi: Ab 6 kele 3 barabar group mein hain, har group mein 2. 1/3 mein neeche ka 3 batata hai kitne barabar group banane hain. Upar ka 1 batata hai kitne group lene hain. Toh 6 ka 1/3 = 2 kele.
point.en: Now 6 bananas are in 3 equal groups, 2 in each group. In 1/3 the bottom 3 tells how many equal groups to make. The top 1 tells how many groups to take. So 1/3 of 6 = 2 bananas.

prompt.hi: Ab 21 kele 3 bachchon mein barabar baante. 21 ka 1/3 kitna hai?
prompt.en: Now 21 bananas are shared equally among 3 children. What is 1/3 of 21?

why.hi: 21 kele 3 barabar group mein baantne par har group mein 7 aate hain, 3 × 7 = 21
why.en: 21 bananas shared into 3 equal groups give 7 in each group, 3 × 7 = 21

simpler.hi: 1/3 ka matlab hai 3 barabar group banao aur 1 group lo. 6 kele 3 group mein baante, toh ek group mein 2.
simpler.en: 1/3 means make 3 equal groups and take 1 group. 6 bananas in 3 groups gives 2 in one group.

explain.convey: 12 marbles → 4 equal groups → 1/4 of 12 = one group = 3; method: bottom number → that many equal groups → size of one group is the answer

point.hi: Yeh 12 kanche 4 barabar group mein hain, har group mein 3. Tarika yeh hai: neeche ka number dekho, utne barabar group banao, aur ek group mein jitne hain, wahi jawab hai. Toh 12 ka 1/4 = 3.
point.en: These 12 marbles are in 4 equal groups, 3 in each group. The method: look at the bottom number, make that many equal groups, and the number in one group is the answer. So 1/4 of 12 = 3.

prompt.hi: Ab 32 kanche hain. 32 ka 1/4 kitna hai?
prompt.en: Now there are 32 marbles. What is 1/4 of 32?

why.hi: 32 kanche 4 barabar group mein baantne par har group mein 8 aate hain, 4 × 8 = 32
why.en: 32 marbles shared into 4 equal groups give 8 in each group, 4 × 8 = 32

simpler.hi: Neeche ka 4 kehta hai, 4 barabar group banao. 12 kanche 4 group mein, toh ek group mein 3, wahi jawab.
simpler.en: The bottom 4 says make 4 equal groups. 12 marbles in 4 groups gives 3 in one group, and that is the answer.

problem.hi: 15 pencil ka 1/3 kitni pencil hota hai?

steps.result: 3 barabar group, unme se 1 group lena

why.hi: neeche ka 3 batata hai kitne barabar group banane hain, aur upar ka 1 batata hai ki 1 group lena hai
why.en: the bottom 3 tells how many equal groups to make, and the top 1 tells us to take 1 group

simpler.hi: 1/3 mein neeche 3 hai, toh 3 barabar group banenge. Upar 1 hai, toh unme se 1 group lena hai.
simpler.en: In 1/3 the bottom is 3, so we make 3 equal groups. The top is 1, so we take 1 of those groups.

prompt.hi: Ab 15 pencil ko 3 barabar group mein baanto, 3 ke pahade se. Ek group mein kitni pencil aayengi?
prompt.en: Now share 15 pencils into 3 equal groups, using the table of 3. How many pencils go in one group?

simpler.hi: 15 pencil ek-ek karke 3 group mein baari-baari se rakho. Jab saari khatam ho jaayein, ek group gin lo.
simpler.en: Put the 15 pencils one by one into the 3 groups in turn. When they are all used up, count one group.

why.hi: 3 × 5 = 15, yaani 3 barabar group mein 5-5 pencil aati hain
why.en: 3 × 5 = 15, so 3 equal groups get 5 pencils each

prompt.hi: 18 laddoo 3 plate mein barabar rakhe. Ravi ne 1 plate li. Ravi ne saare laddoo ka kitna hissa liya, fraction mein batao.
prompt.en: 18 laddoos are put equally on 3 plates. Ravi takes 1 plate. What fraction of all the laddoos did Ravi take?

why.hi: 18 laddoo 3 barabar plate mein the, har plate mein 6; Ravi ne unme se 1 plate li, yaani 1/3
why.en: the 18 laddoos were on 3 equal plates, 6 on each; Ravi took 1 of them, that is 1/3

simpler.hi: Laddoo kitni barabar plate mein bante, woh neeche aata hai. Ravi ne kitni plate li, woh upar aata hai.
simpler.en: The number of equal plates the laddoos are shared on goes at the bottom. The number of plates Ravi took goes on top.

prompt.hi: 16 kanche 4 group mein baante: 7, 3, 3 aur 3. Kya 7 wala group saare kanchon ka ek-chauthaai hai?
prompt.en: 16 marbles are put into 4 groups of 7, 3, 3 and 3. Is the group of 7 one-quarter of all the marbles?

accept: no, the groups are not equal

why.hi: group 7, 3, 3, 3 barabar nahi; 16 ke ek-chauthaai mein har group 4 ka hota, 4 × 4 = 16
why.en: groups 7, 3, 3, 3 are not equal; quarters of 16 would be 4 in each group, 4 × 4 = 16

simpler.hi: Ek-chauthaai ke liye 4 group barabar hone chahiye. Dekho ki 7, 3, 3 aur 3 sab barabar hain ya nahi.
simpler.en: For one-quarter, the 4 groups must be equal. See whether 7, 3, 3 and 3 are all the same.

ladder.why: thirds of a set as sharing among 3 friends → 3 equal groups
one-third in a word problem without the sharing story spelled out
quarters of a bigger set → 4 equal groups
name the fraction of the set and find the amount, both
two fractions of the same set in one problem → half and quarter

remediation.move: map the plates onto a bar: 3 plates ↔ bar of 3 equal parts; whole bar = all the laddoos = bottom; shaded part = Ravi's plate = top; plates left are not the bottom

say.hi: Poori patti saare laddoo hain, aur iske 3 barabar hisse neeche ka 3 hain. Ravi ki 1 rangin plate upar ka 1 hai.
say.en: The whole bar is all the laddoos, and its 3 equal parts are the bottom 3. Ravi's 1 shaded plate is the top 1.

simpler.hi: Poori patti matlab saare laddoo. Uske 3 barabar hisse neeche aate hain, aur Ravi ki 1 plate upar.
simpler.en: The whole bar is all the laddoos. Its 3 equal parts go at the bottom, and Ravi's 1 plate on top.

prompt.hi: 20 kele 4 thailon mein barabar bhare. 1 thaila kisi ko de diya. Saare kelon ka kitna hissa diya, fraction mein batao.
prompt.en: 20 bananas are packed equally into 4 bags. 1 bag is given away. What fraction of all the bananas was given away?

why.hi: 20 kele 4 barabar thailon mein the, har thaile mein 5; unme se 1 thaila diya gaya, yaani 1/4
why.en: the 20 bananas were in 4 equal bags, 5 in each; 1 bag was given away, that is 1/4

simpler.hi: Kele 4 barabar thailon mein hain, toh neeche thailon ki ginti aati hai. Upar utne thaile aate hain jitne diye.
simpler.en: The bananas are in 4 equal bags, so the count of bags goes at the bottom. On top go the bags that were given away.

remediation.move: fair-share test on the same 16 marbles: uneven groups 7 + 3 + 3 + 3 beside equal groups 4 + 4 + 4 + 4 → only equal groups make quarters

say.hi: 16 kanche ke alag group 7 + 3 + 3 + 3 barabar nahi hain. 16 ke barabar group 4 + 4 + 4 + 4 hain, toh sirf wahan har group 1/4 hai.
say.en: The 16 marbles in groups 7 + 3 + 3 + 3 are not equal. The equal groups of 16 are 4 + 4 + 4 + 4, so only there each group is 1/4.

simpler.hi: 7 + 3 + 3 + 3 barabar group nahi hain. 4 + 4 + 4 + 4 barabar hain, toh sirf wahan har group 1/4 hai.
simpler.en: 7 + 3 + 3 + 3 are not equal groups. 4 + 4 + 4 + 4 are equal, so only there each group is 1/4.

prompt.hi: 12 pencil ke group bane: 6, 3 aur 3. Kya 6 wala group saari pencilon ka ek-tihaai hai?
prompt.en: 12 pencils are split into groups of 6, 3 and 3. Is the group of 6 one-third of all the pencils?

why.hi: group 6, 3, 3 barabar nahi; 12 ke ek-tihaai mein har group 4 ka hota, 3 × 4 = 12
why.en: groups 6, 3, 3 are not equal; thirds of 12 would be 4 in each group, 3 × 4 = 12

simpler.hi: Ek-tihaai ke liye 3 group barabar hone chahiye. Dekho ki 6, 3 aur 3 barabar hain ya nahi.
simpler.en: For one-third, the 3 groups must be equal. See whether 6, 3 and 3 are equal or not.

bridgeToNext.hi: Wahi 8 laddoo dekho: 8 ka 1/2 = 4, aur 8 ka 1/4 = 2. Jitne zyada barabar group, utna chhota hissa. Ab ek hi cheez ke 1/2, 1/3 aur 1/4 ki tulna karenge.
bridgeToNext.en: Look at the same 8 laddoos: 1/2 of 8 = 4, and 1/4 of 8 = 2. The more equal groups, the smaller each share. Next we compare 1/2, 1/3 and 1/4 of one whole.

hook.convey: one cake (or one drawn strip) shared into 2 vs the same-size one into 4 → which single piece is bigger; more equal parts of the same whole → smaller piece

use.hi: Ek birthday cake 2 dost baant rahe hain. Bilkul waisa hi doosra cake 4 dost baant rahe hain. Aaj pata karenge ki kis cake mein har dost ka tukda bada hai.
use.en: Two friends are sharing a birthday cake. Four friends are sharing another cake exactly like it. Today we find out in which cake each friend's piece is bigger.

use.hi: Do barabar lambi patti draw karo. Ek ko 2 barabar hisson mein baanto, doosri ko 4 mein. Dono mein ek-ek hissa colour karo. Aaj dekhenge kaunsa rangin hissa bada hai.
use.en: Draw two strips of the same length. Split one into 2 equal parts and the other into 4. Colour one part in each. Today we see which coloured part is bigger.

explain.convey: bar cut into 2 equal parts → one part = 1/2; shaded part reaches the middle of the bar; predict: same bar in 4 parts → is one part bigger than the half? no

point.hi: Yeh patti 2 barabar hisson mein bati hai. Rangin hissa patti ka aadha hai, yaani 1/2. Dekho, yeh patti ke beech tak jaata hai.
point.en: This bar is split into 2 equal parts. The shaded part is half the bar, that is 1/2. See, it reaches the middle of the bar.

prompt.hi: Ab isi patti ko 4 barabar hisson mein kaatein. Kya tab ek hissa is aadhe se bada hoga?
prompt.en: Now we cut this same bar into 4 equal parts. Will one part then be bigger than this half?

why.hi: wahi patti 4 barabar hisson mein bate toh har hissa 1/4 hai, yaani 1/2 ka bhi aadha
why.en: when the same bar is in 4 equal parts, each part is 1/4, half of 1/2

simpler.hi: Patti ke 2 barabar hisse hain, aur rangin hissa beech tak jaata hai. Yeh aadha hai, yaani 1/2.
simpler.en: The bar has 2 equal parts, and the shaded part reaches the middle. This is half, that is 1/2.

explain.convey: same bar cut into 4 equal parts → one part = 1/4; shaded part much shorter than the half on the last board
